Northwind Health is hiring a Data Analyst

Location: Remote (United States)
Employment type: Full-time

Northwind Health helps clinics understand their patient outcomes. Our analytics team turns messy claims data into dashboards that care teams actually use.

As a Data Analyst you will:
• Write SQL to clean and join claims and EHR data
• Build and maintain Tableau dashboards for clinic leadership
• Partner with product managers to define metrics and run A/B test readouts
• Document data definitions so everyone works from the same numbers

You might be a fit if you have:
• A bachelor's degree in statistics, economics, computer science or similar
• 0–2 years of experience in an analytics role (internships count)
• Strong SQL; Python or R is a plus
• Clear written communication

We offer competitive pay, medical/dental/vision coverage, and a home-office stipend.
